scope: Compiler execution and SDK/static-runtime/launch qualification before product build
required: Actual pinned compiler launches and compiles the retained source with warnings as errors.
Each resulting executable launches inside the confined worker and reports its actual pointer width and compiler identity.
Both executables report AppContainer=1, elevation=0 and outside write denied with error 5.
Actual working filesystem capacity is at most 512 MiB; compiler TEMP/output stays in its owned work.
Retain exact commands, bounded compiler/import/launch observations, executable hashes and PE machine identities.
No physical storage, host test media, shared toolchain ACL changes, installation or guest reboot.
Owned processes/profiles are retired before image removal; uncertainty preserves the bounded image.
Remove generated executables, objects, image and temporary transfers; retain compact evidence only.
